description: This file defines a utility class 'CollectionsUtil' providing static methods for collection operations such as checking emptiness, computing differences, concatenation, and element comparison.

classes.name: CollectionsUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for collection operations.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a collection or map is null or empty.

methods.name: isNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a collection or map is not null and not empty.

methods.name: diffSets
methods.description: Returns a set with elements present in set B but absent in set A.

methods.name: diffLists
methods.description: Returns a list with elements present in list B but absent in list A.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a collection contains a specific element.

methods.name: countNonNull
methods.description: Counts non-null elements in an array.

methods.name: mapOf
methods.description: Creates a map from an array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: emptyOrContains
methods.description: Checks if a collection is empty or contains a specific element.

methods.name: concat
methods.description: Concatenates two sets into a new set.

methods.name: isOneOf
methods.description: Checks if a value equals any of the provided others.

methods.name: elementsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two iterables are element-wise equal based on a custom equality predicate.

methods.name: addToSet
methods.description: Adds a value to a set, returning a new set if necessary.
